title: Uhpgray-ed Taahm
description:
Alright, let's git into thuh juicy stuff.  Ya've gawt yo-wr saddle, right? well, [it's taahm for jus' a lidl uhpgray-ed](image:tumblrbumblr:textures/quests/upgraded_saddle.png:124:62).  Makin' an equippin' one will ope-yn uhp a variety awf other slots for various tools.
Thuh fuhrst one, an prolly thuh easilyest known one, is storayge.  Ya kay-yun equip ary a chest or ender chest ta yo-wr hoss for a bit mo-wr storayge
